propositions: compact.py (798 LOC) is a god module bundling transaction logic, snapshot reconstruction, and CLI surface with high cyclomatic complexity (CCN 24, 21)
Extraction into compact_txn.py (transaction + shared primitives) and compact_rebuild.py (rebuild engine) with compact.py as facade reduces main file to ~275 LOC and decomposes by responsibility
Shared primitives (_git_author, _snapshot_strip_keys, _build_authorship_ledger, _git) must live in compact_txn to avoid circular imports between txn and rebuild modules

The rebuild counter (_REBUILD_COUNT, get_rebuild_count) must co-locate in compact_rebuild.py with rebuild_snapshot_from_full_log to ensure module-global updates are visible to callers through re-exports
Monkeypatch test seams in test_compact_negative.py must be repointed from the facade to compact_txn because _compact_locked now reads globals from its extracted module
Public re-exports from compact.py preserve all consumer import paths (fsck_repair, fsck_restore, test suite) with no caller edits required
